QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] A Quick Look Back
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your origins to regain your lost memory. Where would that be for someone who only just reentered this world after being sealed for hundreds of years? Maybe it's the place you met Lania.
QuestInfo.1: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your origins to regain your lost memory. Where would that be for someone who only just reentered this world after being sealed for hundreds of years? Maybe it's the place you met Lania.
QuestInfo.2: You feel a warm energy surround you just by having a short conversation with Lania.
